mapper.select: select from payment where order_no = #{orderNo} and status in (20, 50) order by paid_at desc, payment_no desc limit 1
select from payment where status in (20, 50) and paid_at >= #{from} and paid_at < #{to} order by paid_at

select payment_no from payment where status in (0, 10) and expire_at is not null and expire_at < now(3) order by expire_at limit #{limit}
mapper.insert: insert into payment (payment_no, order_no, user_id, request_id, channel, pay_type, amount, status, channel_trade_no, prepay_id, expire_at) values (#{paymentNo}, #{orderNo}, #{userId}, #{requestId}, #{channel}, #{payType}, #{amount}, #{status}, #{channelTradeNo}, #{prepayId}, #{expireAt})
mapper.update: update payment set status = #{status}, closed_at = now(3) where payment_no = #{paymentNo} and status in (0, 10)
